nodes.label: User
nodes.description: User/Customer entity. Visible as top-left blue-header table in ERD. Has multiple columns; serves as the owner of Cafes and the actor who makes Bookings.

nodes.label: Cafe
nodes.description: Branch/Cafe entity. Visible as top-center blue-header table in ERD. Owned by User (1:N owns) and referenced by Bookings (1:N at). Has per-branch config fields.

nodes.label: Vehicle
nodes.description: Vehicle entity in rental fleet. Visible as top-right blue-header table in ERD. Has 1:N relationship to Cafe and 0:N optional link to Booking.

nodes.label: Booking
nodes.description: Booking entity. Central hub of the ERD, visible as the large green-header table in the center. Connected to User (customer makes), Cafe (at), Vehicle (optional), and downstream to Session, PaymentComponent, and Inspection/Dispute.

nodes.label: ExtensionProposal
nodes.description: ExtensionProposal or ConfirmCode entity. Visible as the orange-header table to the right of Booking in ERD. Has a 1:N relationship from Booking. Contains FK column to Booking.

nodes.label: Session
nodes.description: Session entity. Visible as bottom-left blue-header table. Has 1:N relationship from Booking, representing actual play sessions created at check-in.

nodes.label: PaymentComponent
nodes.description: PaymentComponent or FnbOrder entity. Visible as bottom-center blue-header table. Has 1:N relationship from Booking. Represents payment ledger entries or F&B orders.

nodes.label: Inspection
nodes.description: Inspection or Dispute entity. Visible as bottom-right red-header table. Has 1:0..1 (optional one) relationship from Booking, indicating at most one record per booking.

edges.label: 1:N owns
edges.source_location: relationship label '1:N owns' between top-left and top-center tables

edges.label: 1:N
edges.source_location: relationship line between top-right and top-center tables
edges.note: Vehicle belongs to a Cafe (1:N from Cafe to Vehicle)

edges.label: 1:N makes
edges.source_location: relationship label '1:N makes' from top-left to center table

edges.label: 1:N at
edges.source_location: relationship label '1:N at' from top-center to center table
edges.note: Booking is placed at a Cafe branch

edges.label: 0:1N
edges.source_location: relationship label '0:1N' from top-right toward center table
edges.note: Vehicle is optionally linked to a Booking (RENTAL mode). Cardinality reads as 0..1:N — vehicle may appear in many bookings but booking may have zero or one vehicle directly (via booking_vehicles join table implied)

edges.label: 1:N
edges.source_location: relationship line '1:N' from center table to right orange-header table
edges.note: A Booking can have multiple ExtensionProposals

edges.label: 1:N
edges.source_location: relationship label '1:N' from center to bottom-left table
edges.note: A Booking can have multiple Sessions (0..N actual play sessions created at check-in)

edges.label: 1:N
edges.source_location: relationship label '1:N' from center to bottom-center table
edges.note: A Booking has multiple PaymentComponent ledger entries

edges.source_location: relationship label '1:0..1' or 'flags' from center to bottom-right red-header table
edges.note: A Booking has at most one Inspection or Dispute record (optional one side)

edges.label: snapshot
edges.source_location: Booking table fields (implied by domain model)
edges.note: Booking stores a booking_snapshot JSON capturing user/pricing data at time of booking for immutability
